identity.name: Darrod Tennis Academy
identity.tagline: Bienvenidos a una experiencia de tenis única. Tu academia de tenis en Maspalomas.
identity.location: Maspalomas / Playa del Inglés, Gran Canaria, Spain
identity.story: Coach-led academy in the south of Gran Canaria, working with Sun Club Tennis Playa del Inglés. All coaches follow one in-house methodology; players rotate between coaches. Head coach is referred to as Daniel/Dani in reviews.

services.name: Junior Tennis
services.description: Technique and footwork, biomechanical study of each player, start of competition.

services.name: Tennis Pro
services.description: Spin variations, match strategy, game patterns, psychology and tailored physical preparation.

services.name: Adult holiday groups
services.description: Improve your game, meet other players, make friends.

services.name: Coaching / tournament support
services.description: Accompaniment at tournaments (text truncated in crawl excerpt).

services.name: Premium hotel service
services.description: Training at your hotel; extra cost.

services.name: Court rental
services.description: Two clay courts and three hard courts, heated pool, bar, pro shop (per Facebook).

toneOfVoice.summary: Warm, energetic and personal. Reviews stress friendliness, professionalism and community; the owner's own voice is casual and enthusiastic, mixing Spanish and English.
toneOfVoice.languageNotes: Site is bilingual ES/EN; EN programmes page still shows Spanish copy. Instagram captions mix ES and EN. Voice is informal (tú).

usps.claim: Single in-house methodology used by all coaches, with players rotating between coaches
Video analysis, eating-habit advice and tailored physical training
Year-round play (365 days) in the Gran Canaria climate
Clay courts; hotel training service for holidaymakers
Tournament pathway: 'more than 9 international tournaments' in Gran Canaria (ITF Juniors, M15, W25, Seniors, GC Yellow Bowl, Tennis Europe U14)

testimonials.quote: Dani y su equipo son increíbles. He aprendido más de tenis en tres días con ellos que en todo un año con otro entrenador.
testimonials.author: Daniel Pérez Ambrosí

testimonials.quote: Esta academia es el lugar perfecto para aprender o mejorar en tenis. También es un lugar donde conocer a personas y hacer amigos.
testimonials.author: Ángel Díaz Manchón

testimonials.quote: Fuimos a Canarias diez días de vacaciones y contactamos con Dani para dar unas clases de tenis. La verdad es que ha sido todo un acierto.
testimonials.author: Jon Martinez

testimonials.quote: Daniel es un profesor muy simpático que sabe evaluar correctamente a jugadores como yo, que estamos en una edad avanzada.
testimonials.author: Rudolf Trafoier

testimonials.quote: My son has been training here this summer while on holiday. He has enjoyed it so much and feels like part of the club already.
testimonials.author: Cas222

Site says two clay courts; Facebook says two clay and three hard courts, heated pool, bar, pro shop.
